WITH holdings_flag AS (
  SELECT investor_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN cost > 0 AND current_value >= 0 AND returns_pct < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_loss_making_holding
  FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001
  GROUP BY investor_id
),
goals_flag AS (
  SELECT investor_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN shortfall > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_underfunded_goal
  FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001
  GROUP BY investor_id
),
reb_flag AS (
  SELECT investor_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN action = 'Buy' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_buy_action
  FROM ATOM_EVENT_REBALANCING_ACTION_001
  GROUP BY investor_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.investor_id, p.investor_name

JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001 h ON h.investor_id = p.investor_id

LEFT JOIN goals_flag gf ON gf.investor_id = p.investor_id
LEFT JOIN reb_flag rf ON rf.investor_id = p.investor_id
WHERE p.risk_tolerance = 'Conservative'
  AND h.liquidity_score < 25
  AND COALESCE(hf.has_loss_making_holding, 0) = 1
  AND COALESCE(gf.has_underfunded_goal, 0) = 1
  AND COALESCE(rf.has_buy_action, 0) = 1;

WITH holdings_per_investor AS (
  SELECT investor_id, COUNT(holding_id) AS num_holdings

  GROUP BY investor_id

cashflow_per_investor AS (
  SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) AS net_cashflow
  FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
  GROUP BY investor_id
),
risk_per_investor AS (
  SELECT investor_id, AVG(risk_score) AS risk_score
  FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001
  GROUP BY investor_id
)
SELECT 
  p.risk_tolerance,
  ROUND(AVG(h.num_holdings), 2) AS avg_holdings_per_investor,

LEFT JOIN cashflow_per_investor c ON c.investor_id = p.investor_id
LEFT JOIN risk_per_investor r ON r.investor_id = p.investor_id
GROUP BY p.risk_tolerance

Question: Across risk tolerance, compare the average scenario shift (new minus current allocation %), average scenario count (0 for investors with no scenario records), and average risk score of investors.

WITH investor_scenario AS (
  SELECT p.investor_id,
         COUNT(sr.scenario_rebalance_id) AS scenario_count,
         AVG(sr.new_allocation_pct - sr.current_allocation_pct) AS scenario_shift_avg
  FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
  LEFT JOIN ATOM_EVENT_SCENARIO_REBALANCING_001 sr ON sr.investor_id = p.investor_id
  GROUP BY p.investor_id
),
investor_health AS (
  SELECT investor_id, risk_score

SELECT p.risk_tolerance,
       ROUND(AVG(s.scenario_shift_avg), 2) AS avg_scenario_shift,

FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
LEFT JOIN investor_scenario s ON s.investor_id = p.investor_id
LEFT JOIN investor_health h ON h.investor_id = p.investor_id
GROUP BY p.risk_tolerance

Question: Across risk tolerance, compare the average net cash flow, average signed cash-flow amount, average total holding value, and average rebalance amount of investors.
Generated SQL:
WITH cash_net AS (
  SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) AS net_cash_flow
  FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
  GROUP BY investor_id
),
cash_avg AS (
  SELECT investor_id, AVG(amount) AS avg_signed_cash_flow
  FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
  GROUP BY investor_id
),
holdings AS (
  SELECT investor_id, SUM(current_value) AS total_holding_value
  FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001
  GROUP BY investor_id
),
rebalance AS (
  SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) AS rebalance_amount
  FROM ATOM_EVENT_REBALANCING_ACTION_001
  GROUP BY investor_id
)
SELECT 
  p.risk_tolerance,
  ROUND(AVG(cash_net.net_cash_flow), 2) AS avg_net_cash_flow,
  ROUND(AVG(cash_avg.avg_signed_cash_flow), 2) AS avg_signed_cash_flow_amount,
  ROUND(AVG(holdings.total_holding_value), 2) AS avg_total_holding_value,
  ROUND(AVG(rebalance.rebalance_amount), 2) AS avg_rebalance_amount
FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
LEFT JOIN cash_net ON cash_net.investor_id = p.investor_id
LEFT JOIN cash_avg ON cash_avg.investor_id = p.investor_id
LEFT JOIN holdings ON holdings.investor_id = p.investor_id
LEFT JOIN rebalance ON rebalance.investor_id = p.investor_id
GROUP BY p.risk_tolerance
ORDER BY p.risk_tolerance;

Preliminary SQL:
WITH holdings_gain AS (
  SELECT investor_id, SUM(current_value - cost) AS total_holding_gain
  FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001
  WHERE cost > 0 AND current_value >= 0
  GROUP BY investor_id
),
investor_risk AS (
  SELECT investor_id, risk_score
  FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001
),
investor_combined AS (
  SELECT h.investor_id, h.total_holding_gain, r.risk_score
  FROM holdings_gain h
  JOIN investor_risk r ON h.investor_id = r.investor_id
),
stats AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(total_holding_gain) AS min_gain,
    MAX(total_holding_gain) AS max_gain,
    MIN(risk_score) AS min_risk,
    MAX(risk_score) AS max_risk
  FROM investor_combined
),
normalized AS (
  SELECT
    ic.investor_id,
    ic.total_holding_gain,
    ic.risk_score,
    CASE
      WHEN s.max_gain = s.min_gain THEN 0.0
      ELSE (ic.total_holding_gain - s.min_gain) / (s.max_gain - s.min_gain)
    END AS norm_gain,
    CASE
      WHEN s.max_risk = s.min_risk THEN 0.0
      ELSE (ic.risk_score - s.min_risk) / (s.max_risk - s.min_risk)
    END AS norm_risk
  FROM investor_combined ic
  CROSS JOIN stats s
),
composite AS (
  SELECT
    investor_id,
    100.0 * ((norm_gain + norm_risk) / 2.0) AS composite_score
  FROM normalized
)
SELECT
  p.investor_id,
  p.investor_name,
  c.composite_score
FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
JOIN composite c ON p.investor_id = c.investor_id
ORDER BY c.composite_score DESC, p.investor_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

Question: Across risk tolerance, compare the average net cash flow, average cash-flow amount, average total sector investment, and average scenario allocation shift (new minus current allocation %) of investors.

  SELECT 
    investor_id,

),

  SELECT

  SELECT investor_id,
         SUM(current_value) AS total_holding_value,

  WHERE cost > 0 AND current_value > 0
  GROUP BY investor_id
),
rebalance AS (
  SELECT investor_id,
         SUM(amount) AS total_rebalance_amount
  FROM ATOM_EVENT_REBALANCING_ACTION_001
  GROUP BY investor_id

  SELECT investor_id,
         AVG(progress_pct) AS avg_goal_progress

LEFT JOIN goal g ON g.investor_id = p.investor_id
GROUP BY p.risk_tolerance

    GROUP BY investor_id

risk_score AS (
    SELECT investor_id, risk_score
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001

investor_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        p.investor_id,
        p.investor_name,
        ncf.net_cash_flow,
        thg.total_holding_gain,
        rs.risk_score
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
    LEFT JOIN net_cash_flow ncf ON p.investor_id = ncf.investor_id
    LEFT JOIN total_holding_gain thg ON p.investor_id = thg.investor_id
    LEFT JOIN risk_score rs ON p.investor_id = rs.investor_id
    WHERE ncf.net_cash_flow IS NOT NULL
      AND thg.total_holding_gain IS NOT NULL
      AND rs.risk_score IS NOT NULL
),
normalized AS (
    SELECT
        investor_id,
        investor_name,
        CASE
            WHEN (MAX(net_cash_flow) OVER () - MIN(net_cash_flow) OVER ()) = 0 THEN 0
            ELSE (net_cash_flow - MIN(net_cash_flow) OVER ()) / (MAX(net_cash_flow) OVER () - MIN(net_cash_flow) OVER ())

        CASE

    FROM investor_metrics
),
composite AS (
    SELECT
        investor_id,
        investor_name,
        100 * (norm_ncf + norm_thg + norm_rs) / 3 AS composite_score
    FROM normalized

FROM composite

composite AS (

        cf.net_cash_flow,

        goal.avg_goal_shortfall,

       ROUND(AVG(c.net_cash_flow), 2) AS avg_net_cash_flow,

  SELECT

WITH net_cash_flow AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('Deposit','SIP','Interest Credit','Tax Refund','Dividend Reinvestment','Lump Sum') THEN amount ELSE -amount END) AS net_flow
    FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
    GROUP BY investor_id
),
holding_gain AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           SUM(current_value - cost) AS total_gain
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001
    WHERE cost IS NOT NULL AND current_value IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY investor_id
),
rebalance_amount AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           SUM(amount) AS total_rebalance
    FROM ATOM_EVENT_REBALANCING_ACTION_001
    GROUP BY investor_id
),
risk_score AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           risk_score
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001
),
investor_components AS (
    SELECT n.investor_id,
           p.investor_name,
           n.net_flow,
           h.total_gain,
           r.total_rebalance,
           rs.risk_score
    FROM net_cash_flow n
    JOIN holding_gain h ON n.investor_id = h.investor_id
    JOIN rebalance_amount r ON n.investor_id = r.investor_id
    JOIN risk_score rs ON n.investor_id = rs.investor_id
    JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p ON n.investor_id = p.investor_id
),
min_max AS (
    SELECT *,
           MIN(net_flow) OVER () AS min_net_flow,
           MAX(net_flow) OVER () AS max_net_flow,
           MIN(total_gain) OVER () AS min_total_gain,
           MAX(total_gain) OVER () AS max_total_gain,
           MIN(total_rebalance) OVER () AS min_total_rebalance,
           MAX(total_rebalance) OVER () AS max_total_rebalance,
           MIN(risk_score) OVER () AS min_risk_score,
           MAX(risk_score) OVER () AS max_risk_score
    FROM investor_components
),
normalized AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           investor_name,
           net_flow,
           total_gain,
           total_rebalance,
           risk_score,
           CASE WHEN max_net_flow = min_net_flow THEN 0
                ELSE (net_flow - min_net_flow) / (max_net_flow - min_net_flow)
           END AS norm_net_flow,
           CASE WHEN max_total_gain = min_total_gain THEN 0
                ELSE (total_gain - min_total_gain) / (max_total_gain - min_total_gain)
           END AS norm_total_gain,
           CASE WHEN max_total_rebalance = min_total_rebalance THEN 0
                ELSE (total_rebalance - min_total_rebalance) / (max_total_rebalance - min_total_rebalance)
           END AS norm_total_rebalance,
           CASE WHEN max_risk_score = min_risk_score THEN 0
                ELSE (risk_score - min_risk_score) / (max_risk_score - min_risk_score)
           END AS norm_risk_score
    FROM min_max
),
scored AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           investor_name,
           100 * (norm_net_flow + norm_total_gain + norm_total_rebalance + norm_risk_score) / 4 AS composite_score
    FROM normalized
)
SELECT investor_id,
       investor_name,
       ROUND(composite_score, 2) AS composite_score
FROM scored
ORDER BY composite_score DESC,
         investor_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

WITH cash_flow AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('Deposit','SIP','Interest Credit','Tax Refund','Dividend Reinvestment','Lump Sum') THEN -amount ELSE amount END) AS net_cash_flow
    FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
    GROUP BY investor_id
),
holdings AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           SUM(current_value - cost) AS total_holding_gain
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001
    WHERE cost > 0 AND current_value IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY investor_id
),
sector_investment AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           SUM(total_investment) AS total_sector_investment
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_SECTOR_ALLOCATION_001
    GROUP BY investor_id
),
scenario_shift AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           SUM(new_allocation_pct - current_allocation_pct) AS total_scenario_shift
    FROM ATOM_EVENT_SCENARIO_REBALANCING_001
    GROUP BY investor_id
),
investor_components AS (
    SELECT p.investor_id,
           p.investor_name,
           cf.net_cash_flow,
           h.total_holding_gain,
           si.total_sector_investment,
           ss.total_scenario_shift
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
    LEFT JOIN cash_flow cf ON p.investor_id = cf.investor_id
    LEFT JOIN holdings h ON p.investor_id = h.investor_id
    LEFT JOIN sector_investment si ON p.investor_id = si.investor_id
    LEFT JOIN scenario_shift ss ON p.investor_id = ss.investor_id
    WHERE cf.net_cash_flow IS NOT NULL
      AND h.total_holding_gain IS NOT NULL
      AND si.total_sector_investment IS NOT NULL
      AND ss.total_scenario_shift IS NOT NULL
),
min_max AS (
    SELECT MIN(net_cash_flow) AS min_net_cash_flow,
           MAX(net_cash_flow) AS max_net_cash_flow,
           MIN(total_holding_gain) AS min_total_holding_gain,
           MAX(total_holding_gain) AS max_total_holding_gain,
           MIN(total_sector_investment) AS min_total_sector_investment,
           MAX(total_sector_investment) AS max_total_sector_investment,
           MIN(total_scenario_shift) AS min_total_scenario_shift,
           MAX(total_scenario_shift) AS max_total_scenario_shift
    FROM investor_components
),
normalized AS (
    SELECT ic.investor_id,
           ic.investor_name,
           CASE WHEN mm.max_net_cash_flow = mm.min_net_cash_flow THEN 0
                ELSE (ic.net_cash_flow - mm.min_net_cash_flow) * 1.0 / (mm.max_net_cash_flow - mm.min_net_cash_flow)
           END AS norm_net_cash_flow,
           CASE WHEN mm.max_total_holding_gain = mm.min_total_holding_gain THEN 0
                ELSE (ic.total_holding_gain - mm.min_total_holding_gain) * 1.0 / (mm.max_total_holding_gain - mm.min_total_holding_gain)
           END AS norm_total_holding_gain,
           CASE WHEN mm.max_total_sector_investment = mm.min_total_sector_investment THEN 0
                ELSE (ic.total_sector_investment - mm.min_total_sector_investment) * 1.0 / (mm.max_total_sector_investment - mm.min_total_sector_investment)
           END AS norm_total_sector_investment,
           CASE WHEN mm.max_total_scenario_shift = mm.min_total_scenario_shift THEN 0
                ELSE (ic.total_scenario_shift - mm.min_total_scenario_shift) * 1.0 / (mm.max_total_scenario_shift - mm.min_total_scenario_shift)
           END AS norm_total_scenario_shift
    FROM investor_components ic, min_max mm
)
SELECT investor_id,
       investor_name,
       ROUND(100.0 * (norm_net_cash_flow + norm_total_holding_gain + norm_total_sector_investment + norm_total_scenario_shift) / 4.0, 2) AS composite_score
FROM normalized
ORDER BY composite_score DESC, investor_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

WITH cash_flow_agg AS (
  SELECT investor_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('Deposit','SIP','Interest Credit','Tax Refund','Dividend Reinvestment','Lump Sum') THEN amount ELSE -amount END) AS net_cash_flow
  FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
  GROUP BY investor_id
),
holding_gain_agg AS (
  SELECT investor_id,
         SUM(current_value - cost) AS total_holding_gain
  FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001
  WHERE cost IS NOT NULL AND current_value IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY investor_id
),
sector_investment_agg AS (
  SELECT investor_id,
         SUM(total_investment) AS total_sector_investment
  FROM ATOM_ENTITY_SECTOR_ALLOCATION_001
  GROUP BY investor_id
),
risk_score_agg AS (
  SELECT investor_id,
         risk_score
  FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001
),
stats AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(c.net_cash_flow) AS min_net_cash_flow,
    MAX(c.net_cash_flow) AS max_net_cash_flow,
    MIN(h.total_holding_gain) AS min_total_holding_gain,
    MAX(h.total_holding_gain) AS max_total_holding_gain,
    MIN(si.total_sector_investment) AS min_total_sector_investment,
    MAX(si.total_sector_investment) AS max_total_sector_investment,
    MIN(r.risk_score) AS min_risk_score,
    MAX(r.risk_score) AS max_risk_score
  FROM cash_flow_agg c
  JOIN holding_gain_agg h USING (investor_id)
  JOIN sector_investment_agg si USING (investor_id)
  JOIN risk_score_agg r USING (investor_id)
)
SELECT
  p.investor_id,
  p.investor_name,
  100.0 * (
    (CASE WHEN s.max_net_cash_flow - s.min_net_cash_flow = 0 THEN 0
          ELSE (c.net_cash_flow - s.min_net_cash_flow) * 1.0 / (s.max_net_cash_flow - s.min_net_cash_flow) END +
     CASE WHEN s.max_total_holding_gain - s.min_total_holding_gain = 0 THEN 0
          ELSE (h.total_holding_gain - s.min_total_holding_gain) * 1.0 / (s.max_total_holding_gain - s.min_total_holding_gain) END +
     CASE WHEN s.max_total_sector_investment - s.min_total_sector_investment = 0 THEN 0
          ELSE (si.total_sector_investment - s.min_total_sector_investment) * 1.0 / (s.max_total_sector_investment - s.min_total_sector_investment) END +
     CASE WHEN s.max_risk_score - s.min_risk_score = 0 THEN 0
          ELSE (r.risk_score - s.min_risk_score) * 1.0 / (s.max_risk_score - s.min_risk_score) END
    ) / 4.0
  ) AS composite_score
FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
JOIN cash_flow_agg c ON p.investor_id = c.investor_id
JOIN holding_gain_agg h ON p.investor_id = h.investor_id
JOIN sector_investment_agg si ON p.investor_id = si.investor_id
JOIN risk_score_agg r ON p.investor_id = r.investor_id
CROSS JOIN stats s
ORDER BY composite_score DESC, p.investor_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

WITH cash_flow_agg AS (
  SELECT
    investor_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('Deposit','SIP','Interest Credit','Tax Refund','Dividend Reinvestment','Lump Sum') THEN amount ELSE -amount END) AS net_cash_flow
  FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
  GROUP BY investor_id
),
rebalance_agg AS (
  SELECT
    investor_id,
    SUM(amount) AS total_rebalance_amount
  FROM ATOM_EVENT_REBALANCING_ACTION_001
  GROUP BY investor_id
),
scenario_agg AS (
  SELECT
    investor_id,
    SUM(new_allocation_pct - current_allocation_pct) AS total_scenario_shift
  FROM ATOM_EVENT_SCENARIO_REBALANCING_001
  GROUP BY investor_id
),
risk_agg AS (
  SELECT
    investor_id,
    MAX(risk_score) AS risk_score
  FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001
  GROUP BY investor_id
),
investor_components AS (
  SELECT
    p.investor_id,
    p.investor_name,
    cf.net_cash_flow,
    rb.total_rebalance_amount,
    sc.total_scenario_shift,
    r.risk_score
  FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
  LEFT JOIN cash_flow_agg cf ON cf.investor_id = p.investor_id
  LEFT JOIN rebalance_agg rb ON rb.investor_id = p.investor_id
  LEFT JOIN scenario_agg sc ON sc.investor_id = p.investor_id
  LEFT JOIN risk_agg r ON r.investor_id = p.investor_id
  WHERE
    cf.net_cash_flow IS NOT NULL
    AND rb.total_rebalance_amount IS NOT NULL
    AND sc.total_scenario_shift IS NOT NULL
    AND r.risk_score IS NOT NULL
),
stats AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    MIN(net_cash_flow) OVER () AS min_ncf,
    MAX(net_cash_flow) OVER () AS max_ncf,
    MIN(total_rebalance_amount) OVER () AS min_rebal,
    MAX(total_rebalance_amount) OVER () AS max_rebal,
    MIN(total_scenario_shift) OVER () AS min_shift,
    MAX(total_scenario_shift) OVER () AS max_shift,
    MIN(risk_score) OVER () AS min_risk,
    MAX(risk_score) OVER () AS max_risk
  FROM investor_components
),
normalized AS (
  SELECT
    investor_id,
    investor_name,
    CASE WHEN (max_ncf - min_ncf) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (net_cash_flow - min_ncf) / (max_ncf - min_ncf) END AS norm_ncf,
    CASE WHEN (max_rebal - min_rebal) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (total_rebalance_amount - min_rebal) / (max_rebal - min_rebal) END AS norm_rebal,
    CASE WHEN (max_shift - min_shift) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (total_scenario_shift - min_shift) / (max_shift - min_shift) END AS norm_shift,
    CASE WHEN (max_risk - min_risk) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (risk_score - min_risk) / (max_risk - min_risk) END AS norm_risk
  FROM stats
),
scored AS (
  SELECT
    investor_id,
    investor_name,
    100.0 * (norm_ncf + norm_rebal + norm_shift + norm_risk) / 4.0 AS composite_score
  FROM normalized
)
SELECT
  investor_id,
  investor_name,
  ROUND(composite_score, 2) AS composite_score
FROM scored
ORDER BY composite_score DESC, investor_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

Preliminary SQL:
WITH net_cash_flow AS (
  SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) AS net_cash_flow
  FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
  GROUP BY investor_id
),
total_rebalance_amount AS (
  SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) AS total_rebalance_amount
  FROM ATOM_EVENT_REBALANCING_ACTION_001
  GROUP BY investor_id
),
risk_score AS (
  SELECT investor_id, risk_score
  FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001
),
avg_goal_shortfall AS (
  SELECT investor_id, AVG(shortfall) AS avg_goal_shortfall
  FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001
  GROUP BY investor_id
),
investor_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    p.investor_id,
    p.investor_name,
    nc.net_cash_flow,
    rb.total_rebalance_amount,
    h.risk_score,
    g.avg_goal_shortfall
  FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
  JOIN net_cash_flow nc ON p.investor_id = nc.investor_id
  JOIN total_rebalance_amount rb ON p.investor_id = rb.investor_id
  JOIN risk_score h ON p.investor_id = h.investor_id
  JOIN avg_goal_shortfall g ON p.investor_id = g.investor_id
),
min_max AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(net_cash_flow) AS min_nc,
    MAX(net_cash_flow) AS max_nc,
    MIN(total_rebalance_amount) AS min_rb,
    MAX(total_rebalance_amount) AS max_rb,
    MIN(risk_score) AS min_risk,
    MAX(risk_score) AS max_risk,
    MIN(avg_goal_shortfall) AS min_sf,
    MAX(avg_goal_shortfall) AS max_sf
  FROM investor_metrics
),
normalized AS (
  SELECT
    im.investor_id,
    im.investor_name,
    CASE WHEN (mm.max_nc - mm.min_nc) = 0 THEN 0
         ELSE (im.net_cash_flow - mm.min_nc) / (mm.max_nc - mm.min_nc)
    END AS norm_nc,
    CASE WHEN (mm.max_rb - mm.min_rb) = 0 THEN 0
         ELSE (im.total_rebalance_amount - mm.min_rb) / (mm.max_rb - mm.min_rb)
    END AS norm_rb,
    CASE WHEN (mm.max_risk - mm.min_risk) = 0 THEN 0
         ELSE (im.risk_score - mm.min_risk) / (mm.max_risk - mm.min_risk)
    END AS norm_risk,
    1 - CASE WHEN (mm.max_sf - mm.min_sf) = 0 THEN 0
             ELSE (im.avg_goal_shortfall - mm.min_sf) / (mm.max_sf - mm.min_sf)
        END AS norm_sf
  FROM investor_metrics im
  CROSS JOIN min_max mm
),
scored AS (
  SELECT
    investor_id,
    investor_name,
    100 * (norm_nc + norm_rb + norm_risk + norm_sf) / 4 AS composite_score
  FROM normalized
)
SELECT
  investor_id,
  investor_name,
  ROUND(composite_score, 2) AS composite_score
FROM scored
ORDER BY composite_score DESC, investor_id ASC
LIMIT 10;
